strings.ValidationInvalidChars: Invalid characters. Only 0-9, A-F, and * (with at least one hex character) are allowed.
strings.SuffixRuleHint: 1-16 hex characters (0-9, A-F) with optional * wildcards, matched against the 16-char Key ID
strings.TierEcoTooltip:
Ultra-low-power background mode on the GPU's lowest power plateau.
Rule: Targets the highest rate on the lowest power floor; automatically yields when another 3D app loads the GPU and resumes once free.
strings.TierBalancedTooltip:
Recommended for everyday use, balancing speed and power efficiency.
Rule: Targets the peak efficiency sweet spot in the low-to-mid power band; smoothly scales or yields to other 3D apps and recovers automatically.
strings.TierEfficiencyTooltip:
High throughput below the full thermal wall while avoiding low-efficiency zones.
Rule: Picks the upper-mid efficiency point (up to 88% full-load power); elastically fills spare headroom alongside games and yields on overload.
strings.TierMaxTooltip:
Full hardware throughput for idle runs or dedicated searches.
Rule: Runs uncapped at 100% and never yields to other apps; refreshes baseline speed only when no other 3D app is contending.
strings.ClearAllConfirmFormat: This will permanently remove {0} locally stored keys.
strings.TraySpeedupMeasuredFormat: Close window to tray for ~{0}% faster speed
strings.TraySpeedupGenericHint: Close window to tray to free UI GPU resources for higher speed
strings.HighIdlePowerHint: High idle GPU power detected (e.g. multi-monitor or max-performance mode); Max tier offers higher efficiency per watt
strings.VaultFullError: The key vault is full. Export any key you want to keep, then delete a record to make room.
strings.VaultSaveFailedError: Could not save the matched key. Search stopped. Check access to the vault and try again.
strings.IncompleteSearchResultsError: The GPU returned incomplete search results. Search stopped and the failed batch was excluded from progress.
strings.SettingTimestampRangeError: Timestamp range must span at least 7 days and cannot exceed today.
